description: Na₄YTa(SiO₄)₃ is Pb (Zr_0.50 Ti_0.48) O_3-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.91 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.57 Å) and three longer (2.62 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.15 Å) and three longer (2.26 Å) Y-O bond lengths. Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.00 Å) and three longer (2.06 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.71 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom.
